After the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Sele (Cathar)|Sele]] served as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] to the fence [[Spa Fon]]. A '''poniard''' was his weapon of choice and he used it to duel [[Jax Pavan]]. Pavan, using a [[Jax Pavan's Velmorian energy sword|Velmorian energy sword]], evaded Sele's attacks and struck him several times until the Cathar warrior surrendered.<ref name="CNII:SOS" />
